summary: Complete Production Attendance Management System with Ethiopian Clock System (Africa/Addis_Ababa timezone), course-linked attendance sessions, strict schedule window enforcement (7:00-7:30 Ethiopian Present, 7:30-7:40 Late Window, 7:40+ Closed), PBKDF2 password verification, duplicate prevention, administrative review and correction workflow, post-cutoff controlled absence finalization, and member & admin dashboard integration.
